title: StoTherm ci EIFS
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The CCMC evaluation describes StoTherm ci as a non-loadbearing exterior insulation and finish system made from a water-resistive barrier, adhesive, insulation board and coating/lamina.
The current compliance opinion lists NBC 2020 and classifies the cited combustible-cladding provision 3.1.5.5 as Acceptable, subject to the evaluation conditions and limitations.
The fire-performance section reports an FSR range of 25–500 under CAN/ULC-S102.2 testing and ties the rated product combinations to listed assembly conditions.

limitations: Product evaluation only; no project plans, building classification, jurisdiction adoption evidence, or site-specific wall assembly is supplied.
Fire-performance data are product/configuration specific and do not decide the performance of an unprovided project assembly.
